Welcome

So glad you're here

Welcome to our home. We are so excited you chose to stay with us at Dusk and we hope you love your stay and Newcastle as much as we do.

Dusk is a beautifully styled one-bedroom apartment on the 9th floor of Arena Apartments, B912/75 Shortland Esplanade, Newcastle. Tucked at the quiet rear of the building with sweeping harbour and city views, and just a short walk to the sand, ocean baths, cafes, restaurants and the light rail.

We prefer to keep in touch via the booking platform you used, and we are quick to reply. Don't hesitate to reach out if you need anything at all.

🌑 Linen📶 Free WiFi🚗 Secure Parking🏙 Balcony & Views🏖 Beach Nearby🧬 Laundry📺 Smart TV🌡 Air Conditioning🥗 Kitchen Essentials💈 Hair Dryer🛁 Quality Bedding

With love,
Carly & Katie · The FAM

The Space

A little apartment with a lot of heart

Good to Know

Everything you need

📶

WiFi

Network: Dusk Newcastle
Password: Thankyou

🌡

Air Conditioning

Ducted reverse-cycle air conditioning. Use the control panel on the kitchen wall to set the mode, temperature and fan speed.

📺

Television

Smart TV in the lounge. Streaming only, with free-to-air apps logged in. Sign into your own Netflix or Stan and remember to log out before you leave.

🧬

Laundry

Washer and dryer in the European-style laundry. Laundry detergent provided. Clothes airer for balcony use.

☕

Kitchen

Gas cooktop, oven, dishwasher, microwave, fridge and freezer. Oil, salt, pepper, coffee and teas all provided.

🌑

Bedroom

Queen bed with cotton sheets. The bedroom can be closed off from the living space for a great night's sleep.

🪑

Sofa Bed

The living room lounge converts to a double sofa bed, comfortable for a third guest or a child. Linen and a doona are in the drawer inside the wardrobe, and spare pillows can be taken from the main bed.

🏙

Balcony & Views

Step out for sweeping harbour and city views, with an outdoor dining table and bar chairs. Made for a sunset drink.

👁

Bins

Garbage room on level B2 of the car park, to the left as you exit the lift. General and recycling bins inside. Please take rubbish down in sealed bags.

Arriving

Check-in from 3:00 PM

⏰

Your Check-in Details

Everything you need to access the apartment, including key collection instructions and entry details, will be sent to you 48 hours before your arrival via the platform you booked through. Please keep an eye out for that message.

Before You Leave

Check-out by 10:00 AM

You will receive a reminder message the evening before your check-out via the platform you booked through.

🧹

Tidy Up

Leave wet towels in the bathroom, stack and run the dishwasher, and take any garbage down to the bin room on level B2.

💡

Turn Off

Turn off all lights, appliances and air conditioning when you leave. We appreciate this during your stay too.

🔑

Return Keys

Lock all doors and windows, then return your keys to the lockbox. Full details will be in your check-out reminder message.

Getting Around

Transport & Parking

🚗

Parking

1

Your secure space — Dusk includes a dedicated secure car space on level P12, space B912. Enter via the driveway at 75 Shortland Esplanade. Maximum height clearance 2.2 metres.

2

Watt Street hill — free all day, 200m from the apartment, on the hill past the police station. Handy for a second car.

3

Street parking out front — free after 5pm weekdays, 1pm Saturdays, all day Sundays.

Do not park in the visitor spots on the podium outside.
🚋

Light Rail

The Newcastle Beach light rail stop is just a few minutes walk. Runs to the Interchange at Wickham, connecting to buses and trains throughout Newcastle.

🚅

Rideshare & Taxi

Uber, Ola and Shebah all operate in Newcastle. Easy pickup from Shortland Esplanade out front.

🚌

Bus

Buses run throughout Newcastle and to the suburbs. Check Transport NSW for timetables and routes.

Get Outside

Beaches, Baths & Walks

Beach · 2 min walk

Newcastle Beach

One of the best surf beaches in Australia. Lifeguards patrol daily. Surf club, change rooms and kiosk on site.

Ocean Pool · 3 min walk

Newcastle Ocean Baths

Iconic Art Deco ocean pool. The Canoe Pool is perfect for families with little ones.

Beach · 10 min walk

Nobbys Beach

Newcastle's most famous beach, great for families and watching dolphins.

Ocean Pool · 15 min walk

Bogey Hole

A must-see carved rock pool in King Edward Park. Spectacular at high tide.

Walk · At your door

ANZAC Memorial Walk

Links to the Bathers Way, a 6km coastal track. Popular at sunrise.

Walk · 10 min walk

Newcastle Harbour Walk

From Nobbys along the foreshore through Queens Wharf to Honeysuckle. Wheelchair friendly.

Walk · 15 min walk

Nobbys Breakwall

Walk to the iconic Nobbys Lighthouse. Watch coal ships guided into the harbour.

Day Walk · 15 min drive

Yuelarbah Track

Great day walk in Glenrock with lookout, waterfalls and picnic spots.

Reserve · 20 min drive

Blackbutt Nature Reserve

182 hectares with wildlife, playgrounds and nature trails. Free entry.

Experiences

Things to Do

🇴🇔
On the Water

Coast XP

Whale watching, dolphin swims and eco tours from the harbour. Absolutely worth it.

🏷 Use code THEFAM for 15% off

coastxp.com.au →
🥂
Distillery

Earp Distilling Co

Newcastle's favourite distillery in Carrington. Spirit School, gin tastings and guided tours. Book ahead.

earpdistillingco.com →
🎥
Cinema

Tower Cinema

Newcastle's beloved independent picture theatre. Check their program for current films and don't miss their Retro Nights, where they screen classic films from the 80s and 90s on the big screen.

towercinema.com.au →
🪓
Activity

Axe Throwing

Maniax Newcastle. Book a lane and hurl axes at targets. Great for groups and way more fun than it sounds.

maniax.com.au →
🍸
Speakeasy Bar

Coal & Cedar

Newcastle's best speakeasy cocktail bar hidden in the heart of the city. No signage, just find the door. Cocktail classes available.

coalandcedar.com →
🎪
Theatre

Civic Theatre

Newcastle's stunning heritage theatre in the heart of the city. Check the program for shows during your stay.

civictheatrenewcastle.com.au →
🔒
Escape Room

Escape Reality

Newcastle's escape room right in the city. Great for groups, couples and a rainy afternoon.

escapereality.com →
🎨
Art Gallery

Newcastle Art Gallery

Free entry. One of the finest regional galleries in Australia with a strong permanent collection. Easy via light rail to Civic.

newcastleartgallery.com.au →
🎷
Live Jazz

Underground Jazz at The Grand

Hidden in the basement of The Grand Hotel, accessed via a laneway off Bolton Street. Live jazz every Tuesday and Thursday. Newcastle's best late-night speakeasy.

thegrandnewcastle.com.au →
🏄️
Surf Lessons

Surfing Lessons

Learn to surf at Newcastle Beach. Several schools operate from the beach. Great for beginners of all ages.

Find a lesson →
🗺
Walking Tours

Newy Tour Co

Local tours covering Newcastle's history, street art and hidden gems. Perfect for first-timers.

newytourco.com.au →
🍷
Day Trip

Hunter Valley Wine Tour

The Hunter Valley is just an hour away and one of Australia's most celebrated wine regions. Newy Tour Co run a brilliant day tour with three wineries, a distillery, cheese and chocolate stops, and return transport from Newcastle.

newytourco.com.au →
🏰
Heritage

Fort Scratchley

Perched above the harbour, this 1882 coastal fort fired its guns in anger just once, during the Japanese submarine shelling of Newcastle in 1942. Guided tunnel tours run daily except Tuesdays at regular intervals (10:30am, 11:30am, 1:10pm, 1:40pm, 2:30pm). No booking needed for groups under 12. Buy tickets at the Artillery Store on arrival. Free entry to the grounds.

fortscratchley.org.au →
⛪
Heritage

Christ Church Cathedral

A survivor of the 1989 earthquake and the Japanese WWII submarine attack. Self-guided tours through stunning stained glass windows and treasures. Climb the tower ($10 donation) for sweeping views from the Hunter River to the ocean. Worth every step.

newcastlecathedral.org.au →

House Rules

A few things to keep in mind

🚫

No Smoking

Completely smoke-free building inside and outside at all times.

🔊

Noise & Neighbours

Please respect our neighbours. Keep the volume low and no noise after 10pm.

🧊

No Parties

No parties or gatherings of any kind permitted in the apartment or common areas.

🐶

No Pets

We are unable to accommodate pets of any kind at Dusk.

Breaking house rules will result in the booking being cancelled without refund. By staying at Dusk, guests agree to comply with the NSW STRA Code of Conduct and the Arena Apartments By-Laws.
